high.title: Minyakita Cooking Oil Smells Like Diesel Fuel, Producer Faces Heavy Sanctions
high.summary: Government-subsidized cooking oil brand Minyakita distributed as food aid in Central Java (Karanganyar, Klaten, Wonogiri) has been found to smell like diesel fuel, prompting the Ministry of Trade to order an immediate recall and investigation. Authorities are coordinating with regional governments and Bulog to contain distribution and replace affected products. This raises serious food safety and supply chain integrity concerns for Indonesia's subsidized cooking oil program, with potential legal sanctions against the producer.

high.title: Tokopedia's Fate After Mass Layoffs: GOTO Confirms No Material Impact on Net Profit
high.summary: Publicly listed PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) has officially disclosed via the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) that Tokopedia's recent organizational restructuring and mass layoffs will have no material impact on its share of Tokopedia's net profit or on e-commerce service fee revenues. GOTO holds 24.99% of Tokopedia while ByteDance (TikTok's parent) controls 75.01%. This disclosure is significant for GOTO investors as it provides clarity on potential financial exposure from the layoffs at one of Indonesia's largest e-commerce platforms.

high.title: Government Launches 3 Economic Stimulus Packages to Protect Public Purchasing Power in H2 2026
high.summary: The Indonesian government has launched a series of economic stimulus packages for the second half of 2026, including 30% discounts on train and Pelni sea transport fares during school holidays and the Christmas/New Year period. Additional incentives include waived port service fees for ferry transportation and VAT borne by the government (PPN DTP) for air transport. These measures are designed to boost public mobility and create a multiplier effect on the broader economy, signaling active fiscal support for consumer spending.

high.title: Ministry of Agriculture Allocates IDR 1.33 Trillion to Develop South Papua as National Food Barn
high.summary: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman has disbursed IDR 1.33 trillion in agricultural aid to South Papua Province as part of a strategic push to establish the region as a major food production hub in eastern Indonesia. The funding covers land development, irrigation, agricultural machinery, seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and agricultural modernization across multiple crop sectors. This large-scale government investment reflects Indonesia's ongoing food security agenda and could have significant implications for agribusiness and related sectors.

high.title: Tokopedia's Fate After Being Hit by Mass Layoff Storm
high.summary: GOTO (GoTo Gojek Tokopedia), which holds 24.99% of Tokopedia shares, confirmed there will be no material impact on net profit following Tokopedia's massive layoffs of approximately 90% of its workforce after TikTok's parent ByteDance took majority control (75.01%). GOTO also assured investors that e-commerce service fee revenue from Tokopedia will remain unaffected. This is significant for GOTO shareholders as it clarifies the financial exposure to one of Indonesia's largest e-commerce restructuring events.

high.title: GOTO Speaks Out on Tokopedia's Mass Layoffs Holding 24.99% Stake
high.summary: GOTO officially disclosed via the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) that it respects Tokopedia's organizational restructuring decisions following TikTok's takeover, which resulted in approximately 90% staff cuts. The company emphasized it holds 24.99% of Tokopedia while ByteDance controls the majority at 75.01%, and confirmed no material financial damage to GOTO's bottom line. This disclosure is critical for GOTO investors monitoring the company's exposure to the Tokopedia restructuring and its implications for Indonesia's e-commerce landscape.

high.title: GoTo Announces Rp 3.5 Trillion Share Buyback
high.summary: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) announced a share buyback program worth up to Rp 3.5 trillion, pending approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (EGMS) on June 18-19, 2026. The buyback will be executed over a 12-month period from June 19, 2026 to June 18, 2027. This is a significant corporate action signaling management's confidence in the company's valuation and is likely to be a positive catalyst for GOTO's share price.

high.title: President Prabowo Appoints Danantara to Handle Electricity Export to Singapore
high.summary: President Prabowo Subianto has designated BPI Danantara to implement cross-border electricity trade cooperation with Singapore, announced during a meeting with Singapore PM Lawrence Wong. Danantara is also tasked with activities in trade, digital economy, digital ecosystem, and cybersecurity. This represents a major strategic mandate for Danantara and signals significant bilateral economic collaboration between Indonesia and Singapore.

high.title: Said Iqbal on Tokopedia-TikTok Mass Layoffs: TikTok Must Be Held Accountable
high.summary: Indonesia's Presidential Special Adviser for Labor Affairs and KSPI President Said Iqbal is demanding accountability from TikTok following mass layoffs at Tokopedia, with reports indicating up to 90% of Tokopedia's workforce may be cut. The layoffs follow TikTok's majority acquisition of Tokopedia and alleged relocation of operations to China. This is a major corporate event signaling significant disruption in Indonesia's e-commerce sector and raising serious labor and foreign investment policy concerns.

high.title: Prabowo Appoints Danantara to Export Electricity to Singapore
high.summary: President Prabowo Subianto has designated BPI Danantara to implement cross-border electricity trade cooperation with Singapore, announced during a meeting with Singaporean PM Lawrence Wong. Danantara is also tasked with activities in trade, digital economy, digital ecosystems, and cybersecurity. This represents a significant expansion of Danantara's strategic role and could have major implications for Indonesia's energy sector and bilateral economic relations.

high.title: Tokopedia Boss Denies Mass Layoffs, Says Over 100 Positions Currently Open for Recruitment
high.summary: Amid viral social media reports of layoffs at Tokopedia and TikTok Shop, Executive Director Stephanie Susilo clarified that the company is actively recruiting for more than 100 positions in Indonesia. The issue has drawn attention from Parliament and the government, with a meeting held between DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, TikTok representatives, and the Minister of Manpower. This development is significant for sentiment around Indonesia's tech and e-commerce sector.

medium.title: Gold Price Rises Rp 25,000 Per Gram Over the Week, Now at This Level
medium.summary: Antam gold prices rose 0.94% over the past week, climbing from Rp 2,645,000 per gram on Monday June 29 to Rp 2,670,000 per gram by Saturday July 4, a gain of Rp 25,000 per gram. Prices initially dipped mid-week to Rp 2,625,000 before recovering strongly from Thursday onward. This weekly performance is relevant for Indonesian retail investors who commonly use Antam gold as a savings and inflation-hedging instrument.

medium.title: Government Communications Agency Defends Selection of BUMN (State-Owned Enterprise) Commissioners
medium.summary: Head of the Government Communications Agency (Bakom) Muhammad Qodari defended the appointment of commissioners with diverse, non-industry-specific backgrounds to state-owned enterprises (BUMN), arguing they bring fresh perspectives to support the government's policy agenda. The appointments have drawn public scrutiny over the suitability of certain nominees. Governance of BUMN commissioners is a recurring concern for investors monitoring corporate oversight quality at Indonesia's major state enterprises.

medium.title: List of Top 10 Countries Whose Citizens Rode the Whoosh High-Speed Train in Indonesia
medium.summary: The Whoosh high-speed train (KCIC) carried 184,740 foreign passengers in the first half of 2026, with Malaysia being the largest contributor at 74,902 passengers, bringing the cumulative foreign ridership since October 2023 to 866,458. This growing international ridership on the Jakarta-Bandung corridor highlights the project's increasing commercial viability and tourism contribution. The data is relevant for investors tracking KCIC's revenue performance and the broader infrastructure investment thesis in Indonesia.

medium.title: Over 1 Million People Benefit from Ferry Fare Discount Program, Reaching 90% of Target
medium.summary: Indonesia's ferry fare discount program, running from June 20 to July 5, 2026 during the school holiday period, has reached 1,086,400 beneficiaries out of a target of 1,206,585 — representing 90.04% completion. The program benefited 907,409 vehicle passengers across 341,210 vehicles and 178,991 walk-on passengers, demonstrating strong uptake of the government's transport stimulus. This reflects the effectiveness of the economic stimulus in driving mobility and consumer activity during the holiday season.

medium.title: Foreign Tourists Quietly Embracing Train Travel in Indonesia: H1 2026 Data Revealed
medium.summary: PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) served 308,874 foreign tourists in the first half of 2026, a 2.54% increase compared to 301,219 in the same period of 2025. The growth indicates that rail travel is becoming an increasingly popular mode of transport among international visitors, enhancing KAI's revenue prospects from the tourism segment. This trend supports the broader narrative of Indonesia's growing appeal as a tourist destination and the role of rail infrastructure in supporting that growth.

medium.title: Government Communications Agency Responds to Controversy Over SOE Commissioner Appointments
medium.summary: The head of Indonesia's Government Communications Agency (Bakom), Muhammad Qodari, has defended the appointment of commissioners from diverse backgrounds to state-owned enterprises (SOEs/BUMN), arguing that varied perspectives help advance the government's agenda. The statement comes amid public scrutiny over several commissioner appointments deemed unsuitable for their respective roles. Governance quality in SOEs remains a key concern for investors, as commissioner composition can influence strategic direction and oversight of major state-owned companies.

medium.title: Minyakita Smells Like Diesel Fuel, Causing Uproar — Producer Faces Heavy Sanctions
medium.summary: Minyakita, Indonesia's government-subsidized cooking oil brand, has been found to smell like diesel fuel in Central Java, affecting recipients of food aid in Karanganyar, Klaten, and Wonogiri regencies. The Ministry of Trade has ordered an immediate recall and replacement of the affected products while a full investigation is underway. Producers face the risk of heavy sanctions, which could have significant implications for the subsidized cooking oil supply chain and related companies.

medium.title: Gold Prices Rise Rp 25,000 Per Gram Over the Past Week — Current Price Update
medium.summary: Antam gold prices rose 0.94% over the past week, climbing from Rp 2,645,000 per gram on Monday June 29 to Rp 2,670,000 per gram by Saturday July 4, 2026, a gain of Rp 25,000 per gram. Prices initially weakened mid-week before recovering strongly from Thursday onward. This weekly performance is relevant for Indonesian retail investors and gold-backed asset holders tracking safe-haven demand.

medium.title: List of 10 Countries Whose Citizens Tried the Whoosh High-Speed Train When Visiting Indonesia
medium.summary: Indonesia's Whoosh high-speed train (KCIC) carried 184,740 foreign passengers in the first half of 2026, with cumulative ridership reaching 866,458 foreign nationals since its launch in October 2023. Malaysian tourists lead foreign ridership with 74,902 passengers in H1 2026, signaling strong regional tourism demand on the Jakarta-Bandung corridor. This growth is relevant for investors tracking KCIC's revenue potential, tourism infrastructure performance, and Indonesia's broader transportation sector.

medium.title: Tokopedia Boss Denies Mass Layoffs, Says Over 100 Positions Currently Open for Recruitment
medium.summary: Amid viral social media reports of layoffs at Tokopedia and TikTok Shop, Executive Director Stephanie Susilo stated the company is currently recruiting for more than 100 positions in Indonesia. The issue has drawn attention from parliament, with Deputy House Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad meeting with TikTok representatives and the Minister of Manpower. This clarification is relevant to GoTo Group investors and the broader Indonesian tech labor market.

medium.title: Tokopedia Executive Says No Layoffs, Only Workforce Restructuring
medium.summary: Tokopedia and TikTok E-commerce Indonesia Executive Director Stephanie Susilo clarified that there are no layoffs (PHK) at TikTok or Tokopedia Group, describing the situation instead as a workforce reorganization. The statement was made following a coordination meeting with Deputy House Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad and the Minister of Manpower. Investors in GoTo Group should monitor this development as workforce restructuring could impact operational costs and company performance.

medium.title: High School and Vocational Graduates Proposed to Join National Internship Program, Minister of Manpower Responds
medium.summary: A member of parliament proposed expanding the National Internship Program — which currently offers stipends equivalent to the regional minimum wage — to include high school and vocational school graduates, not just university and diploma holders. Minister of Manpower Yassierli indicated that expansion could potentially be implemented from the third batch if regulations permit. This policy development is relevant to businesses that rely on entry-level labor and could affect workforce supply dynamics.

medium.title: 4,000 Companies Register for National Internship Program, Offering 130,000 Positions
medium.summary: Indonesia's Minister of Manpower Yassierli reported that 4,000 companies have registered on the MagangHub platform within one week of the National Internship Program 2026 launch, proposing approximately 130,000 internship positions. The government will verify these positions and apply a maximum ratio of one intern per five full-time employees, with a first-batch quota of 50,000 out of a total 150,000 annual slots. This program signals government efforts to address youth unemployment and workforce development amid rising layoff pressures.

medium.title: Minister of Manpower Reveals Strategy to Prevent Layoff Wave in Manufacturing Industry
medium.summary: Minister of Manpower Yassierli outlined the government's approach to preventing mass layoffs in Indonesia's manufacturing sector, centered on a dedicated Layoff Task Force (Satgas PHK) led by the Minister of State Secretariat. The task force implements an early warning system to identify at-risk sectors and addresses specific layoff cases proactively. This is relevant for investors in Indonesian manufacturing equities as it reflects growing government concern over employment stability in a key economic sector.

medium.title: Indonesia and Singapore Collaborate on Carbon Market Management to Boost Green Economy
medium.summary: Indonesia and Singapore signed two strategic MoUs on environmental cooperation and carbon credit collaboration under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement during a bilateral Leaders' Retreat between President Prabowo Subianto and PM Lawrence Wong. The agreements position environmental protection as a core pillar of bilateral relations and open pathways for cross-border carbon trading between the two nations. This is significant for Indonesian ESG and green economy investors as it formalizes Indonesia's role in the growing regional carbon credit market.

medium.title: Unilever Plans Investment in North Sumatra's Sei Mangkei Special Economic Zone, Groundbreaking Next Month
medium.summary: Unilever Global is set to make a significant investment in the Sei Mangkei Special Economic Zone (KEK) in Simalungun Regency, North Sumatra, with a groundbreaking ceremony planned for next month. The investment aims to establish a global supply chain hub (global value chain) for the multinational company. This signals growing confidence in Indonesia's SEZ infrastructure and could attract further foreign direct investment to the region.

medium.title: Tokopedia Executive Says No Layoffs Occurred, Describes Situation as 'Workforce Restructuring'
medium.summary: Tokopedia and TikTok E-commerce Indonesia's Executive Director Stephanie Susilo stated that there have been no layoffs (PHK) at TikTok or Tokopedia Group, characterizing recent workforce changes as a 'workforce restructuring.' The statement was made following a coordination meeting with DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad and the Minister of Manpower. Investors in the tech sector should monitor this situation as regulatory and parliamentary scrutiny of the company intensifies.

medium.title: SMA/SMK Graduates Proposed to Join National Internship Program, Minister of Manpower Responds
medium.summary: A DPR Commission IX member has proposed expanding the National Internship Program — which currently provides stipends equivalent to regional minimum wages — to include SMA and SMK graduates, not just university and diploma graduates. Minister of Manpower Yassierli indicated that expansion could be considered for the third cohort, pending review of existing regulations. This policy development is relevant to Indonesia's labor market and workforce development landscape.
